raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Depends on #45126. This draft includes the parent changes; [view only this follow-up](https://github.com/leonardHONG/sglang/compare/0bdc4b842fa91d1d91dae08ca35046926cc1b982...15f15e4c794b90174b1ac306551e520f1e7d7729).

## Motivation

Single-token decode repeatedly prepares fixed MoE routing layouts and waits for GEMM2 before loading metadata that is already ready. This PR reduces that overhead on top of the front-sharding path in #45126.

## Modifications

- Reuse single-row mappings and padding, and write expert IDs and weights directly from the routing kernel. Keep the native FC1/FC2 kernels and autotuner.
- Prefetch routing metadata and norm weights before the PDL wait, preserving the dependency on GEMM2 data and the arithmetic order.
- Use one shared-expert AllReduce block instead of four for the eligible single-row path.

## Accuracy Tests

- Generated tokens match the baseline for all 30 measured requests, 64 warmups and 3 boundary requests in each mode.
- DFlash verification, accepted-draft and proposed-draft counts match exactly.
- TP8 M1/M8 eager execution and CUDA Graph replay with updated inputs pass 208 bitwise checks.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kimi-K3 on 8×B300, TP8, concurrency 1, 8192 input / 1024 output tokens. Same inputs and client, 64 warmups with 32 output tokens and 30 measured requests per mode, without profiling. The baseline already includes the front-sharding optimization in #45126.

| Mode | Baseline decode | This PR decode | Speedup | E2E latency |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Native decode | 125.75 tok/s | 131.49 tok/s | +4.56% | 8600.49 → 8236.88 ms |
| DFlash | 206.73 tok/s | 206.79 tok/s | +0.03% | 5423.28 → 5452.95 ms |

Native-decode E2E latency decreases by 4.23%. DFlash shows no additional speedup.

[Reproduction scripts](https://gist.github.com/leonardHONG/82b9737d8ea25336420d7c46504a5be4) include the service launcher, fixed-input generator, streaming client and timing calculation. Model, source and output paths are supplied by the user.

+"""Layer-owned quantized latent shards for the merged Kimi front projection."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.communication.all_reduce import Communicator, PullPlane
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe.moe_route_quant_fused import (
+    QuantGather,
+    available,
+    route_quant_fused,
+)
+from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce_v2 import (
+    _SEMAPHORE_BYTES,
+    _allocate_symmetric_memory,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_buffer
+
+# Serving wins measured for single-token decode and an eight-token verify block.
+# The gather kernel itself takes a runtime row count.
+FRONT_SHARD_ROWS = (1, 8)
+
+
+def sharded_front_available(group, hidden_size: int) -> bool:
+    def check():
+        # All TP ranks must select the same collective path.
+        ready = torch.tensor(
+            [available(group.world_size, hidden_size)], dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu"
+        )
+        dist.all_reduce(ready, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group.cpu_group)
+        return bool(ready.item())
+
+    return get_buffer(
+        f"k3_front_gather_available_{group.unique_name}_{hidden_size}", check
+    )
+
+
+class KimiK3FrontWorkspace:
+    def __init__(self, group, num_layers: int, hidden_size: int, max_tokens: int):
+        from flashinfer.fused_moe import core
+
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+        self.rank = group.rank_in_group
+        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        local_groups = hidden_size // group.world_size // 32
+        scale_stride = (local_groups + 15) // 16 * 16
+        self.scale_row_bytes = group.world_size * scale_stride
+        scale_start = num_layers * max_tokens * hidden_size
+        scale_end = scale_start + num_layers * max_tokens * self.scale_row_bytes
+        sem_start = (
+            (scale_end + _SEMAPHORE_BYTES - 1) // _SEMAPHORE_BYTES * _SEMAPHORE_BYTES
+        )
+        num_blocks = 2 * max_tokens
+        total = sem_start + num_blocks * _SEMAPHORE_BYTES
+        with torch.inference_mode(False):
+            self.region, self.handle = _allocate_symmetric_memory(
+                total, device, group.cpu_group
+            )
+        self.region[sem_start:].zero_()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        dist.barrier(group=group.cpu_group)
+        peers = [
+            self.handle.get_buffer(i, [total], torch.uint8)[sem_start:].view(
+                num_blocks, _SEMAPHORE_BYTES
+            )
+            for i in range(group.world_size)
+        ]
+        mc_base = int(self.handle.multicast_ptr)
+        # Separate from the shared expert's overlapping AllReduce semaphore plane.
+        self.comm = Communicator(
+            pull=PullPlane(
+                self.rank,
+                group.world_size,
+                semaphores=peers,
+                mc_semaphore=mc_base + sem_start,
+            )
+        )
+        self.quantized = (
+            self.region[:scale_start]
+            .view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            .view(num_layers, max_tokens, hidden_size)
+        )
+        self.scales = (
+            self.region[scale_start:scale_end]
+            .view(torch.int32)
+            .view(num_layers, max_tokens, group.world_size, scale_stride // 4)
+        )
+        self.q_mc = mc_base
+        self.scale_mc = mc_base + scale_start
+
+        self._routing_slot_type = getattr(core, "TrtllmMoERoutingMetadataSlot", None)
+        self.routing = None
+
+    def route(self, layer_id, scores, bias, local_x, config):
+        rows = scores.shape[0]
+        assert rows <= self.max_tokens
+        if rows == 1 and self.routing is None and self._routing_slot_type is not None:
+            self.routing = SingleTokenRouting(
+                scores.device, scores.shape[1], config.top_k, self._routing_slot_type
